name: Prildaz
description: Prildaz was the Yevethan name of the third planet in the ILC-905 system in the Farlax sector in the Galactic Core. It was a barren dustball orbited by the Imperial shipyard Black Nine. The New Republic defeated the Yevethan defense of Black Nine.
